text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through the hall on the way
to my
office when...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Forty minutes and thirty seconds have
passed.
Let's take a break, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's gotten so late already... Sorry,
but I can't
solve this problem.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I took into consideration
your
attention span and tendency to
fixate on difficult
problems when
creating the timetable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You needn't feel rushed. We'll be able
to cover
all the test material without
issue at our current
pace.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Flash... I really appreciate
this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Think nothing of it. I take
enjoyment in
teaching you since you
grasp new material so
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Two minutes, thirty-four seconds have
elapsed.
Prepare to resume. I'm certain
you can figure out
the problem after one
more attempt.
I wonder about that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I just happened to overhear
your
conversation while doing some
research.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Tachyon! What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm just wondering if Scarlet might be
slipping
back into her bad habits is all.
Just the other
day...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the wait, Scarlet. This
treatment
agent is the byproduct we'll
be researching
toda—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Dried rheum around the orbicularis oculi,
and
edema of the upper arm and
zygomaticus major
muscle...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems what you truly require before
your test is
a sofa in a dim environment
in which you can
acquire restful sleep.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon! I asked you to keep that
between us!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me you have been
studying
outside our sessions and even
going so far as to
forgo sleep?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Urk! I'm sorry... I just really want to get
the
number one score again, so...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, it is I who should apologize. It's my
fault for
acting as your tutor while failing
to comprehend
your needs and wants.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To remedy this, I must ask Tachyon to
enlighten
me about this side of you I
don't know.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will use the information I gain to create
a more
efficient schedule that better fits
your needs!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Don't go digging for more

embarrassing stories about me! I'm
embarrassed
enough already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! You're Flash's trainer, aren't
you?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you stop her now, um... Flash won't
have to work as
hard and can focus on
training better!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Please don't try to stop me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A better understanding of your tutee
leads to
increased efficiency. As an
instructor, surely you
understand.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A better understanding of your tutee
leads to
increased efficiency. As an
instructor, surely you
understand.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And that would be?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's a fine solution. Tachyon can
make up
for anything I don't know about
Scarlet, and we
can cover double the
amount of material at once.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'd feel doubly ready with two
teachers
helping me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall draft a new schedule
right away.
One minute and fifteen
seconds should suffice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While I don't mind contributing, I have
an
experiment planned after this, Flash.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If I had assurance that I could conduct
an
equivalent experiment to make up for
the one I
won't get to perform today, I'd
be more inclined
to help.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about I help you with
the task
you mentioned yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you offering to participate in
my study
on the differences between
one's biological clock
and real time?
Very well, then!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've adjusted my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For five minutes, I will explain how to
solve a
practice question pertaining to
the material.
Then, Tachyon will give
you problems that use
the same rules.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right! Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Eishin Flash is having a
really good
time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, I'd greatly appreciate it if you
could
share your knowledge on Scarlet's
bad habits
right away.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-wait! Wouldn't that be a waste of
time?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's not a problem. It won't take me
longer than an
hour and ten minutes to
gather information on
you and organize
it all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The improved efficiency will compensate
for the
lost time, so we technically won't
be going past
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While I don't mind contributing, I have
an
experiment planned after this, Flash.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If I had assurance that I could conduct
an
equivalent experiment to make up for
the one I
won't get to perform today, I'd
be more inclined
to help.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about I help you with
the task
you mentioned yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you offering to participate in
my study
on the differences between
one's biological clock
and real time?
Very well, then!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin at once. It would behoove us
to tackle
these questions as quickly as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was not sure how things would turn out,
but I'm
relieved to know I can count on
your support.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-well, I'm not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Eishin Flash is having a
really good
time!
